name: jqml
description: Syntax highlighting, completions and diagnostics for the JQML engine

jqml.enginePath.description: Optional path to a JQML v3 engine root. Leave empty to use the types bundled in the extension.

jqml.configPath.description: Path to a JQML compiler JSON config with dirs/includes. Absolute path, ${workspaceFolder}, and ${env:NAME} are supported. IMTCOREDIR/PROLIFEDIR/TARGETNAME are inferred from this file if they are not in the environment.

jqml.env.description: Optional environment variables used when resolving ${IMTCOREDIR}, ${PROLIFEDIR}, ${TARGETNAME} and similar placeholders in compiler configs.

jqml.hideInternalMembers.description: Hide engine-internal members such as JQ* and AX/AY from completions.
